purpose: Demonstrate an action or declare determination to achieve it.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
The teacher demonstrated how to fold it.
I will pass next time, you will see.
I will definitely fix the broken clock.
restrictions: Literal demonstration and determined promise are distinct uses.
mistake: It is not the tentative trial meaning of てみる.

segments.role: Demonstrate an action or declare determination to achieve it. Vて + みせる
